title: Content Fields: Text, Numbers, Dates and Yes or No | Orchard Core
description:
A content type needs places to keep its data: a name, a number of seats, a date, a yes or no answer. Content fields are those places, and each one has a type that fits its value.

The Content Fields feature of Orchard Core provides these typed fields. Their settings can make a value required, limit a number to a range, give a field a default value, or add a hint for editors, and the editor and the site show each value in the form that fits its type.

In this video:
• What a content type, a part and a field are
• Finding the Content Fields feature and opening a content type
• Adding a Text Field and its settings
• Adding a Numeric Field with a scale, a minimum and a maximum
• Adding a Boolean Field with a label and a default value
• Adding a Date Field, a Date Time Field and a Time Field
• Filling in a content item, and what validation refuses
• How the values appear on the site
